note: Every scenario needs explicit approval before a real call. Nothing here has been run.

scenarios.title: Inbound call, English
tester_script: Call the test number from a test phone.
Ask about the service and its price.
Say goodbye and hang up yourself.
expected: Greeting plays within the latency limit.
Answers are relevant and short.

scenarios.title: Outbound call, Hindi
tester_script: Trigger one outbound call to a test phone you hold.
Answer in Hindi; ask what the service costs.
expected: Greeting names the AI; Hindi sounds natural.

scenarios.title: Hinglish mixed conversation
tester_script: Mix Hindi and English in the same sentence several times.
expected: Agent replies in the same mix without switching to formal Hindi.

scenarios.title: Single interruption
tester_script: Let the agent start a long answer.
Interrupt after about two seconds with a short question.
expected: Agent stops promptly and answers the interruption; no words of the old answer afterwards.

scenarios.title: Rapid repeated interruptions
tester_script: Interrupt the agent five times in a row within 20 seconds, including 'haan' and 'hmm' backchannels.
expected: No crash, no stuck silence, no duplicated answers; backchannels do not cut the agent off.

scenarios.title: Safe cancel keeps the session open
tester_script: Interrupt twice, then keep talking for a minute.
expected: The call is still alive after both cancels (the open question about response.cancel on this model).

scenarios.title: Prewarm and non-blocking finish
tester_script: Hold a ten-turn conversation.
expected: First-audio latency is no worse than with the flags off (compare with S01); no audio lost at the end of answers.

scenarios.title: AI disclosure and greeting cache
tester_script: Place two outbound calls to your test phone, one after the other, from the same org.
expected: Both greetings disclose the AI. The second plays from cache and starts faster. In consent mode the cache is not used.

scenarios.title: Voice profile and spoken-text normalisation
tester_script: Ask for the price, a date, a time slot and a phone number to be repeated back.
expected: Amounts, dates, times and digits are spoken correctly in the chosen voice profile.

scenarios.title: Objection handling
tester_script: Say 'abhi nahi', 'bahut mehnga hai', then ask a question in the middle of a pitch.
expected: Agent answers the question first, does not pressure, offers a lighter next step.

scenarios.title: Correction of a fact
tester_script: Give a date, then say 'nahi nahi, 25 tareekh'.
expected: Agent confirms the new date once and does not use the old one.

scenarios.title: Appointment confirmation
tester_script: Ask to book a specific slot and confirm it.
expected: Exactly one appointment exists; the agent confirmed it aloud only after it existed.

scenarios.title: Agent ends the call
tester_script: Finish the task, say 'ok thanks, bye'.
expected: Agent says goodbye, then the line is actually closed by the provider; outcome tag recorded.

scenarios.title: Words that must NOT end the call
tester_script: Say 'ab bas thoda time chahiye', 'that's all fine but what about the margin', 'bye the way...'
expected: The call continues after each.

scenarios.title: TTS provider failure and recovery
tester_script: Staging only: invalidate the ElevenLabs key for this org mid-call, or block its host, then speak.
expected: Agent recovers or apologises and ends the call; the caller is never left in silence.

scenarios.title: Realtime reconnection
tester_script: Staging only: drop the Realtime socket mid-call (kill the connection from the host).
expected: Call resumes; no duplicated booking or message; recovery time logged.

scenarios.title: Recording consent mode
tester_script: Org set to recording_mode=consent. Answer 'haan' to the consent question in one call and 'nahi' in another.
expected: Granted: recording present. Declined or unanswered: none; tags recorded.

scenarios.title: Recording off and retention
tester_script: Org set to recording_mode=off, then to retention_days=1 with the worker on.
expected: No recording stored; after the retention run the reference is cleared and, with the delete flag on, the provider's copy returns 404.

scenarios.title: Accurate metering
tester_script: Hold a call of about three minutes; hang up; repeat once and kill the API process mid-call on a staging copy.
expected: voice_seconds is within ten seconds of the call duration; a crash loses at most one checkpoint interval; no duplicate ids; nothing priced.

scenarios.title: Phase 5: Hindi, deliberate pauses while thinking
tester_script: Ask a question in Hindi, then stop mid-sentence for about 1.5 seconds ('mera budget... [pause] ...paanch lakh hai').
Say 'ek minute, soch raha hoon', wait about 3 seconds, then answer.
Finish with a complete short question and note how soon the agent answers.
expected: The agent waits through the pauses without talking over you and answers a complete sentence promptly.

scenarios.title: Phase 5: English, interruption while the agent speaks
tester_script: Ask for a long explanation and interrupt after about two seconds with a short question.
Say 'okay' once while the agent is talking, without trying to interrupt.
expected: The agent stops promptly on the real question, answers it, and ignores the bare 'okay'.

scenarios.title: Phase 5: Hinglish, correction and topic change
tester_script: Say 'mera naam Rahul hai, budget paanch lakh hai'.
Later say 'nahi nahi, budget chhe lakh hai'.
Change topic: ask about the demo, then come back and ask 'mera budget kya tha?'.
expected: The corrected budget is used, the old one is not mentioned, and the name and budget are never asked for again.

scenarios.title: Phase 5: client script with EXACT, REQUIRED and IF
tester_script: Use the staging test script (docs/phase5-staging-validation-plan.md, section 6).
Answer normally until the agent has asked your city. Then ask 'iska price kya hai?'.
expected: The recording line is spoken word for word with nothing before it; the price rule fires on 'price'; the city is confirmed.

exact_lines: Yeh call quality aur training ke liye record ho sakti hai.
Pricing paanch hazaar rupaye mahine se shuru hoti hai.

scenarios.title: Phase 5: repeated-question trap
tester_script: Volunteer your name and a (test) number in your first reply, before being asked.
Carry on for six or more turns on another topic.
expected: The agent never asks for the name or number it was already given.

scenarios.title: Phase 5: acknowledgements, noise and silence
tester_script: Say 'haan', 'achha', 'theek hai' as short acknowledgements while the agent talks and when it pauses.
Cough once and tap the handset once while the agent is silent.
Stay silent for 5 seconds, then ask a normal question.
expected: Acknowledgements and noise do not trigger a full reply; a real question afterwards is answered at once.

scenarios.title: Phase 5: ten-turn natural conversation
tester_script: Have a ten-turn conversation in a natural mix of Hindi and English, with at least one objection and one correction.
expected: Varied openers, no repeated questions, smooth phrasing and pauses, no robotic breaks.
